brief:
Agricultural nurseries in Gaza are resuming operations, marking an initial step toward reviving the territory's farming sector. The move comes as conditions allow for limited economic activity to resume in parts of the enclave, according to Ma'an Wire.

The restart of nursery work represents efforts to rebuild Gaza's agricultural infrastructure following prolonged disruptions. Farmers are preparing seedlings and plants as a foundation for broader agricultural recovery in the coming months.
title: Gaza's nurseries signal agriculture sector's slow restart
